lines.text: We burned the midnight oil last night.

data.define: To keep working late into the night.

example.text: We burned the midnight oil last night.

misuse.text: Don't say it about lighting candles.

data.l1_hook: ما زلت تعمل حتى الثانية صباحاً؟ هل تقوم بـ "burn the midnight oil"؟
data.l1_ex: لقد قمنا بـ "burn the midnight oil" الليلة الماضية.

native.tip: “burn the midnight oil” = يسهر الليالي في العمل. مثال: “We burned the midnight oil last night.”
